name: Do I need permits for barrier-free home modifications in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for barrier-free home modifications in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many barrier-free home modifications, especially those involving structural changes, electrical work, plumbing, or significant alterations to the footprint of your home, typically require permits from your local city or county building department. This is to ensure that the work complies with safety codes and local regulations in places like Pacifica, Daly City, or San Francisco. Smaller cosmetic changes or the installation of non-structural accessibility aids might not require permits. City Dweller, LLC can guide you through the permit application process and ensure all work adheres to necessary building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are often required for structural, electrical, or plumbing modifications. City Dweller, LLC assists with the permit process to ensure code compliance.
